verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML compliance platform, so a gated approval before submitting a regulatory report (such as a SAR) is a fair question for it. The evidence covers screening, risk scoring, case management and case decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted/offboard'). It never mentions regulatory report submission or a required authorized sign-off before filing. Case decisions are an adjacent control and earn no credit toward this story.
